question: A sum of money is to be distributed among A, B, C, and D in the ratio of 14 : 7 : 11 : 10. If C gets ₹196 more than B, how much did A receive?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **A : B : C : D** is **14 : 7 : 11 : 10**.

Difference between **C** and **B** in ratio units = 11 − 7 = **4 units**.

Given, 4 units = **₹196** → 1 unit = **₹49**.

Share of **A** = 14 units = 14 × 49 = **₹686**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹686.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e14d46e398019283ca20c8b93d3bb5f0108ffa82af641113a47aafa75f2d889d.png] 

**Given:**

Ratio of **A : B : C : D** = 14 : 7 : 11 : 10

Let the shares be **14x, 7x, 11x,** and **10x**.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Share of **C** − Share of **B** = 196

⇒ 11x − 7x = 196

⇒ 4x = 196

⇒ x = 196 ÷ 4 = **49**

⇒ Share of **A** = 14x = 14 × 49

⇒ Share of **A** = **686**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹686.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

If a sum **S** is divided in the ratio **a:b:c**, then the share of the first part is [a / (a + b + c)] × **S**.

Difference Rule

The difference between any two shares in a ratio is proportional to the difference in their respective ratio terms.
